fullPassage: Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? One part of the answer may lie in the greater social complexity and inclination for cooperation with large numbers of conspecifics found in humans relative to non-humans. Unlike most animals, humans have multilayered societies, although hamadryas baboons (Papio hamadryas hamadryas) and bottle-nosed dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) have layered societies that approach the complexity of that of humans in that there is cooperation between higher-level social units. Humans are, however, probably unique in the extent to which there is cooperation even between individuals who barely know one another or have not even met, but who are either distant kin or are symbolically connected in some way. Such cooperation would probably be impossible without the aid of language, which enables people to deliver messages to others. * prone to ~할 가능성이 있는 ** conspecific 동일 종 *** hamadryas baboon 망토개코원숭이

❌ ④ extent(정도): 범위나 정도를 뜻하며 경향과 무관

questions.passage:
(A) The new employee's skills and experience <u>approach</u> those of a senior manager. Dolphin societies <u>approach</u> the complexity of human societies.

(B) We decided to <u>approach</u> the problem from a different angle. The committee will <u>approach</u> the issue with caution.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 approach의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 approach는 '(수준에) 접근하다/근접하다', (B)의 approach는 '(문제에) 접근하다/다루다'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 근접하다 — (B) 다루다: (A)는 능력/복잡성 수준에 '근접하다', (B)는 문제를 '다루다/접근하다'
❌ ② (A) 다루다 — (B) 근접하다: 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (A) 근접하다 — (B) 근접하다: (B)는 문제를 '다루다'가 맞음
❌ ④ (A) 다가가다 — (B) 근접하다: (A)는 물리적 접근이 아닌 수준의 '근접'
det.tip: approach: (수준에) 근접하다 / (문제를) 다루다. 목적어 종류로 구분

questions.passage: One part of the answer may lie in the greater social __________ (complex) and inclination for cooperation with large numbers of conspecifics found in humans.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

complex → ____

det.korean: 복잡성(complexity). 더 큰 사회적 '복잡성'이라는 명사 자리.
det.analysis: the greater social ___ and inclination 구조에서 빈칸은 형용사 greater와 social의 수식을 받는 명사 자리. complex(형용사) → complexity(명사). social complexity = '사회적 복잡성'.
det.tip: complex(복잡한, 형용사) → complexity(복잡성, 명사). -ity 접미사가 명사를 만듦

questions.passage: Such cooperation would probably be impossible without the aid of language, which __________ (able) people to deliver messages to others.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

able → ____

det.korean: 가능하게 하다(enables). 언어가 사람들이 메시지를 전달할 수 있게 '해준다'는 동사 자리.
det.analysis: which ___ people to deliver 구조에서 빈칸은 주격 관계대명사 which 뒤의 동사 자리. 선행사 language(3인칭 단수). able(형용사) → enables(동사, 3인칭 단수). enables people to deliver = '사람들이 전달할 수 있게 해준다'.
det.tip: able(형용사) → enable(동사) → enables(3인칭 단수). en- 접두사가 동사를 만듦

questions.passage: Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? One part of the answer may lie in the greater social complexity and inclination for cooperation with large numbers of conspecifics found in humans relative to non-humans. Unlike most animals, humans have multilayered societies, although hamadryas baboons (Papio hamadryas hamadryas) and bottle-nosed dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) have layered societies that approach the complexity of that of humans in that there is cooperation between higher-level social units. Humans are, however, probably unique in the extent to which there is cooperation even between individuals who barely know one another or have not even met, but who are either distant kin or are __________ connected in some way. Such cooperation would probably be impossible without the aid of language, which enables people to deliver messages to others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 상징적으로(symbolically). 먼 친척이거나 어떤 방식으로 '상징적으로' 연결된 사람들이라는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① physically(물리적으로): 만난 적도 없는 사람들이 물리적으로 연결되었다는 것은 모순
❌ ② accidentally(우연히): 친척이거나 '우연히' 연결되었다는 것은 맥락에 부적합
❌ ③ temporarily(일시적으로): '일시적으로' 연결되었다는 것은 협력의 기반으로 약함
✅ ④ symbolically(상징적으로): 원문 — 먼 친척이거나 상징적으로 연결된 사람들

questions.passage: Assuming that humans are more prone to creating social norms, moral rules, and laws than are non-humans, what might explain this difference? One part of the answer may lie in the greater social complexity and inclination for cooperation with large numbers of conspecifics found in humans relative to non-humans. Unlike most animals, humans have __________ societies, although hamadryas baboons (Papio hamadryas hamadryas) and bottle-nosed dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) have layered societies that approach the complexity of that of humans in that there is cooperation between higher-level social units. Humans are, however, probably unique in the extent to which there is cooperation even between individuals who barely know one another or have not even met, but who are either distant kin or are symbolically connected in some way. Such cooperation would probably be impossible without the aid of language, which enables people to deliver messages to others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 다층적인(multilayered). 대부분의 동물과 달리 인간은 '다층적인' 사회를 가진다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① primitive(원시적인): 인간 사회가 '원시적'이라는 것은 사회적 복잡성과 모순
✅ ② multilayered(다층적인): 원문 — 인간의 사회가 여러 층으로 구성됨
❌ ③ homogeneous(동질적인): 다양한 수준의 협력을 설명하는 맥락에 부적합
❌ ④ isolated(고립된): 사회적 협력을 강조하는 맥락에 정반대
